verdict.rationale: Mollie's refunds docs say refunds can be created through the API endpoint and also manually in the Mollie Web app (dashboard), which covers both channels. Partial refunds via the API are implied by the idempotency docs' warning that a retried refund can create two separate partial refunds, and the Magento integration explicitly supports full or partial refunds. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the dashboard supports partial (not just full) refunds, in-depth Refunds API reference detail (endpoints, amount parameters), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
